speaker: Doctor
text: The fact that the lesions are painless and nonpruritic, combined with the recent exposure to a child with similar lesions, suggests a contagious condition, though the history of chickenpox in the brother is noted. text: My main symptom is Skin-colored, nontender, pearly papules with central umbilication on the abdomen and extremities.

text: The description of pearly papules with central umbilication is highly suggestive of Molluscum contagiosum.
